messages:
sasha: quick idea — proposing a schema tweak: make anchors explicit snapshots + a short-lived lease handshake so rollbacks and rehydrates are unambiguous. anyone object?

maria: +1 in principle. can you sketch the minimal fields? trying to avoid >10 keys per rollout manifest.

sasha: sure. something like: 
```json
{
  "anchor": "snapshot:v2.1+sha256:abc123",
  "content_hash": "sha256:abc123",
  "lease_token": "lt-20250301-42",
  "epoch": "42",
  "compat_bands": ["decoder:>=1.2", "embeddings:<2.0"],
  "fallback_order": ["quantized-8", "fp16"]
}
```

alex: that looks fine. couple notes: (1) lease_token should be short-lived and revocable by control plane; (2) content_hash is required for client verification if they care about exact bits.

priya: what about clients that only speak semantic versions? we can't force them to check hashes. thinking of dual fields: semantic_version and content_hash.

sasha: yep. add `semantic_version` optional. key idea: resolver uses anchor+lease as primary; semantic_version is just a user-facing label.

simon: operational concern: when we `rehydrate` a model (same semantic_version but different content_hash) we need a signal so routing can prefer a pinned variant or opt-in new bits. lease_token can help, but we also need a `soft_update` flag in rollout metadata.

maria: +1 on `soft_update`. if `soft_update: true` then client resolver may continue to prefer the cached content_hash until a probe passes. otherwise immediate switch.

sasha: agree. propose these new fields: `soft_update`, `forced_rollout_ts` (optional), and `compatibility_checksum` (a quick runtime fingerprint to detect behavioral regressions).

alex: compatibility_checksum is tricky — how do we compute? small eval-suite hash? might be noisy but useful for quick guardrails.

priya: for backward compatibility we should version the schema itself: `schema_version: "2025-01-01-v1"`. clients that don't understand new fields ignore them. servers must maintain old behavior if schema_version absent.

sasha: good call. also propose we accept both lease tokens and epoch-style leases for older infra for a transition window. server will emit whichever it owns and a canonical `lease_token` will be present in new manifests.

ops-bot: deploybot: rollout manifest accepted for staging. note: existing clients (v1) will ignore `compatibility_checksum` and `soft_update`.

maria: telemetry: please add these telemetry keys: `manifest_applied:bool`, `resolver_fallback_used:enum`, `compat_check_passed:bool`, `rehydrate_event:enum` (manual/auto). that'll help us tune defaults.

alex: migration plan idea: 1) publish schema v1 and server returns `schema_version` in rollout metadata; 2) server emits both `legacy_lease` and `lease_token` for 30 days; 3) clients adopt shim that prefers `lease_token` when present; 4) after 30d we stop legacy_lease.

priya: also add deprecation annotation: `deprecate_after_ts` so control plane can flag TTL/soft-deprecation windows per variant.

sasha: edge case: rollback of content_hash to an earlier build that shares same semantic_version — ensure `rollback` is explicit. suggest `rollout_intent: ["replace", "rollback"]` field.

simon: operational checklist: make sure routing respects `fallback_order` + `soft_update` + tenant-level pin overrides. otherwise we'll surprise prod owners.

maria: question: do we want a separate small boolean `immutable_anchor` meaning the anchor must never be re-used for another content_hash? makes audits easier.

sasha: yes. `immutable_anchor: bool` default false. if true, attempting to register a different content_hash under the same anchor is an error.

alex: quick sample manifest with these ideas: 
```json
{
  "schema_version": "2025-01-01-v1",
  "anchor": "snapshot:2025-03-01:v2.1",
  "content_hash": "sha256:abc123",
  "semantic_version": "2.1",
  "lease_token": "lt-20250301-42",
  "epoch": 42,
  "soft_update": true,
  "immutable_anchor": true,
  "compatibility_checksum": "e3b0c442",
  "fallback_order": ["quantized-8", "fp16"]
}
```

priya: love it. next steps? RFC + small compat shim PR. we need an SDK change to expose `manifest` fields to end-users and a console UI update for `soft_update` / `deprecate_after_ts`.

sasha: action items: i'll open RFC with schema draft + migration timeline. alex — can you prototype client shim? maria — add telemetry hooks and the console UI ticket. simon — add ops runbook notes for rollback + immutable_anchor violations.

alex: yep, will do a quick PR for the shim w/ tests.

maria: filing the console ticket now. linking it to RFC when ready. :+1:

sasha: thanks all. I'll drop the RFC link here when created.

ops-bot: note: RFC created by sasha: https://rfd.internal/2025/anchored-snapshot-lease-handshake (auto)
